title: TSM Healthcare Thermal Continuity: Governed Facility Intelligence
_note: Scripted scenario: engine outputs are canned via tests/e2e/helpers/stub-war-room.js, not live model output. Captions are DRAFTS. Narration lines are DRAFTS too: spoken text for --narrate, numbers written as words.

states.caption: Healthcare Thermal Continuity war room
states.narration: This is the Healthcare Thermal Continuity war room. It protects the spaces a hospital cannot afford to lose. What follows is a simulated incident.

states.caption: HVAC failure report loaded
states.narration: A chiller plant fault in the east tower is raising supply-air temperature in three zones, including the surgical suite. The operator loads the failure report.

states.caption: Six engines complete: risk scored 77/100
states.narration: Six engines read it. The surgical suite and pharmacy storage reach their temperature limits within three to six hours, and four scheduled procedures are affected. Exposure runs from three hundred fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand dollars. The risk score is seventy-seven out of one hundred.

states.caption: Operations Strategist receives the healthcare relay
states.narration: One click escalates the case to the Operations Strategist, which shows the exposure with action, and without it.

states.caption: Executive Portal with the healthcare relay
states.narration: The Executive Portal shows the decision: deploy temporary cooling to the surgical suite within two hours, for forty-five thousand dollars. The system recommends. The facilities director decides.
